images.author: Harry Loots
images.why: Dramatic Simien escarpment with a grassy ridge above deep valleys, photographed during the author's trek. Strong vertical depth for a 9:10 crop; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: BDU Fellowship VLM
images.why: Green highland valleys and layered mountain scenery explicitly located in the Semien Mountains, Ethiopia. Canon camera photograph; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Bruce Beron
images.why: Photographer's landscape titled 'Simien Mountain Scenic', within his Ethiopia photography collection. Landscape-focused alternative; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Willian Justen de Vasconcellos
images.why: 3835 × 2557. Expansive cloud reflections on the actual Salar de Uyuni; the sky-mirror composition provides a strong near-square crop. Sony camera photograph taken January 2025.

images.author: Leonardo Rossatti
images.why: 5683 × 3197. Classic geometric salt crust extending toward the horizon beneath clear blue sky; ample resolution for a 9:10 crop. Location explicitly identifies Uyuni, Bolivia.

images.author: NASA / ISS Expedition 30 crew
images.why: Actual astronaut photograph of Mauritania's Richat Structure, captured with a Nikon D2Xs and 400 mm lens. Recognizable concentric rings suit a near-square card; source offers a 2.78 MB JPEG but does not state pixel dimensions.

images.author: NASA / ISS Expedition 63 crew
images.why: Real Nikon D5 astronaut photograph showing the Richat Structure surrounded by extensive Saharan dune fields. Broader landscape alternative; source offers a 5.21 MB JPEG but does not state pixel dimensions.

images.author: Shreosi Swarnakar
images.why: 4160 × 3119. Sculptural White Desert rock formations against a saturated blue sky, with warm desert tones. Landscape framing offers useful room for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Alfred Franz
images.why: 2000 × 3008. White Desert formations beneath vivid blue sky; documented Nikon D70 photograph taken in 2004. Portrait alternative that can be cropped to 9:10.

images.author: Dirk Pothen
images.why: 5160 × 3870. Classic Serengeti acacia, open plains and wildebeest beneath blue skies. Tanzania location and camera metadata are supplied; generous resolution for a near-square crop.

images.author: ross green
images.why: 3840 × 2754. Serengeti plains, acacia trees and a dirt track beneath a vibrant sky. Documented Tanzania photograph taken in 2018; the track provides depth for a poster crop.
